title: Linear transformations, null space, range, and the rank-nullity theorem
objectives: Verify linearity and compute range and null space
Define a linear map by its values on a basis and test other prescriptions
Prove the rank-nullity theorem and its consequences
Deduce that row rank equals column rank
prerequisites: Chapters 2, 4 and 6: echelon forms, bases, dimension and row space.
source_scope: The captions of Lectures 11 and 12 were read in full; the additional propositions, the infinite-dimensional boundary and the exercises are original.
